communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

All available contracting and procurement documents and communications, including requests for proposals (RFPs) and/or requests for quotes (RFQs); all bids and proposals; all executed contracts with amendments, extensions, and supportive materials (active and expired); and any related agreements between Colorado Department of Corrections and private correctional healthcare corporations, and/or health care entities (hospitals, clinics, etc.) that were active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025. This includes any documents related to contracts from before 2001, but active during the period of interest.

If healthcare operations for incarcerated individuals in Colorado State Prisons were contracted to any entities other than the entities above, including but not limited to other universities and university systems, we request the same available documents active or published between January 1, 2001 and December 31, 2025.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Elizabeth Evans-Ralston
